included: protected RTDIN_P hardware window with RTDIN_N LOW return and upstream-powered supervisor/fault NAND
standalone J1 probe and J2 host interfaces; firmware protocol correspondence
firmware resistance thresholds and register encoding

assumptions: PT100 IEC 60751 alpha=0.00385; product accuracy criterion is steady-state 100 C; 0 to 250 C is retained only as a bounded extended-range analysis

boundary_constraints: No MCU, buck converter, or host harness is connected by this standalone source proposal.

Host pin-1 orientation, mating continuity, final plated-hole dimensions, and cable EMC remain physical acceptance items.

rtd_measurement.node_model: The executable RTDIN comparator model solves the actual force/sense lead network, paired diagnostic pullups, protected RTDIN_P input, RTDIN_N-referenced LOW divider, and REF2025 VBIAS HIGH divider. register_code_formula.low_short_inclusive: code_low=floor(32768*R_short/RREF)+1, including when the exact boundary is an integer, so every ADC code below code_low trips low
register_code_formula.high_open_inclusive: code_high=floor(32768*R_open/RREF); ADC codes strictly above code_high trip the high comparator, matching decoded-resistance >=R_open on the ADC code lattice.

topology.low: TLV3201 INP=protected RTDIN_P window node through shared 100 kohm; INN=61.9k from REF2025.VBIAS to 10k to RTDIN_N; low_ok iff window > INN + offset

hardware_window.verdict: PASS bounded passive polarity model with the 100 kohm protected RTDIN_P branch for healthy 100..194.1 ohm and each individual FORCE+, FORCE-, SENSE+, SENSE- open; accepted 1 ohm harness and separate 50 ohm robustness sweep both retain a comparator fault margin.
limits: The deck and Python generator are external passive/DC models; they do not model MAX internal switches, ADC conversion, or shutdown timing.

The unit passive harness transient contract is -0.2..+2.5 V per conductor relative to unit ground, source impedance >=1 kohm, edge time >=10 us, pulse width <=1 ms, repetition <=1 Hz. Its 2.7 V span fits the TLV3201 minimum 2.7 V supply, so the bounded comparator differential is <= supply and clamp sum is zero.

The MAX31865 +/-45 V RTDIN absolute maximum is a device limit only, not a unit transient immunity claim. With the allowed source contract, the 100 kohm RTDIN_P branch has no clamp current; a +45 V hypothetical device-only event is outside the unit contract.

The RTDIN_N LOW-divider path is included in the passive model; its threshold node remains within the TLV functional input range under the allowed envelope. A device-only +/-45 V event would drive the 10 kohm path into the TLV input clamp and is explicitly outside the unit contract.

The runtime transient model starts from healthy 100 or 194.1 ohm and opens each conductor independently using the actual C0G/parasitic RC at the RTDIN pins. FORCE+/FORCE- cross in 1 us; SENSE+/SENSE- cross in 0.329/0.046 ms worst case at a conservative 20 mV comparator overdrive. Adding sourced 55 ns TLV3201 and conservative 10 ns logic propagation gives <=0.329065 ms unit detector time; the analytic maximum-RC envelope gives <=1.323576 ms at 20 mV overdrive.

Local post-ferrite loss is not treated as a powered comparator result. External source drive is forbidden while local RTD_AVDD is absent; the rail monitor/HW fault protocol owns shutdown. The passive stored-energy bound is 4.7385 nJ into >=0.18 uF local capacitance, <=0.229456 V worst rail rise, with clamp sum zero; this Cmin requires each of four nominal 100 nF post-rail bypasses to characterize >=45 nF at voltage and temperature.

rtd_measurement.critical_gap: The selected paired 1 Mohm diagnostics and 1 nF C0G (+5% tolerance) with <=200 pF parasitic give worst temperature-adjusted RC tau 1.373 ms and 10.5 tau 14.414 ms. Direct hardware coverage now uses both TLV3201 comparators at protected RTDIN_P and the LOW divider bottom at RTDIN_N; it does not rely on the MAX ADC filter for conductor coverage. The 65536-corner passive model and separate ngspice case runs cover all four individual opens, accepted 1 ohm accuracy harness, 50 ohm robustness, +/-5 nA TLV input bias, board leakage, REF2025 loading, local-off collapse, and the declared -0.2..+2.5 V passive transient envelope. Runtime digital freshness and MAX internal conversion behavior remain separate firmware concerns; comparator transient behavior is bounded only for the declared envelope. EMC, physical wiring, and shutdown timing remain physical/system validation items; the conditional SINC phase artifact remains separate and must not be treated as vendor timing proof.

rail_monitor.package: WSON-6 DSE, 1.5 x 1.5 mm, 0.5 mm pitch
rail_monitor.source_buck_feedback_assumptions: LMR51430 VFB 0.591..0.609 V, 100k/22.1k feedback resistors +/-1%, opposing 100 ppm/C TCR over 60 C, and +/-50 nA FB leakage; the source's declared 3.135..3.465 V envelope is retained as the acceptance bound
rail_monitor.ct_configuration: CT left unconnected; TI no-capacitor propagation delay is approximately 25 us minimum. No added release delay is assumed in the assertion budget.
rail_monitor.corner_method: Vtrip=(Vthreshold-Iin*Rth)*(Rtop+Rbottom)/Rbottom; independent +/-0.1% resistor tolerance, opposing +/-25 ppm/C TCR over 60 C, +/-100 nA SENSE current, and 1% threshold accuracy. Rising bound conservatively applies max VITN accuracy and max 0.825% hysteresis.
rail_monitor.verdict: PASS bounded rail guard: falling trip minimum 3.006010 V is above the MAX31865 3.0 V minimum, and rising clear maximum 3.114708 V is below the 3.1332 V minimum valid local RTD_AVDD rail. This closes the deterministic low-valid-rail release corner in the source/model envelope; reset transients, rail ramp, PCB parasitics, and physical loss behavior remain NOT RUN.

diagnostic_bias.healthy_load_model: Paired network includes 430 ohm RREF/RTD, 1 ohm sense lead/contact resistance, pullup +/-5% and independent +/-14 nA input leakage; worst RTD=194.1 ohm error is 0.1845 mV, about 0.084 ohm or 0.22 C in this passive model
diagnostic_bias.runtime_fault_assumption: A conductor open is present before BIAS startup for the <=90 ms startup-open bound. Direct hardware detection is bounded separately by the RTDIN-pin transient model at <=1.323576 ms under the declared passive unit envelope. The historical third-order-boxcar SINC phase artifact remains conditional and is not used for the direct hardware conductor bound; its arithmetic is 40.8998 ms + 17.6 ms + 10 ms + 5 ms + 14.4144 ms = 87.9142 ms, with one contaminated sample possible. This is an engineering assumption, not a vendor-guaranteed runtime proof.

runtime_filter_evidence.datasheet_facts: MAX31865 specifies a 60 Hz continuous conversion period of 16.7..17.6 ms and says the first conversion after enabling continuous mode takes the single-conversion time of 52..55 ms; it labels the block a 50/60 Hz digital SINC filter but gives no filter order, step-response, phase-reset, or transition-sample acceptance guarantee
runtime_filter_evidence.bounded_model_assumption: The companion rtd_sinc_phase_model.txt treats the path as a causal third-order cascade of rectangular windows at T=17.6 ms. Its h3 phase response flushes in 3T=52.8 ms; a post-flush conversion can require one further <=17.6 ms period. This is a standard boxcar assumption, not a vendor implementation claim.
runtime_filter_evidence.phase_crossings: Using normalized r=RRTD/RREF with conservative clipping to 0..1, SENSE+ healthy 100 ohm to high boundary 300 ohm crosses at 28.912 ms; SENSE- healthy 194.1 ohm to low boundary 10 ohm crosses at 40.8998 ms. The physical force/RREF path remains intact during the break.
runtime_filter_evidence.closure_needed: Vendor step-response/order evidence or an instrumented arbitrary-break test must confirm filter history clearing and transition detection before claiming the 100 ms runtime requirement closed

proposed_protocol_budget_ms.sequence: enable BIAS (0x80), wait 2 ticks, one-time automatic fault (0x84), wait 1 tick, continuous conversion (0xC0), wait falling DRDY, read RTD data first then fault status; leave continuous conversion armed

timing.spi_margin: MAX31865 5 MHz maximum; source uses mode 1 and 500 kHz
timing.critical_gap: The selected paired 1 Mohm diagnostics and 1 nF C0G (+5% tolerance) with <=200 pF parasitic give worst temperature-adjusted RC tau 1.373 ms and 10.5 tau 14.414 ms. Direct hardware coverage uses both TLV3201 comparators at protected RTDIN_P and the LOW divider bottom at RTDIN_N; it does not rely on the MAX ADC filter for conductor coverage. The executable runtime model puts the modeled capacitance on RTDIN_P/RTDIN_N, starts from healthy 100/194.1 ohm, and opens each conductor; worst threshold crossing is 0.329 ms at 20 mV comparator overdrive and unit detector time is 0.329065 ms with sourced 55 ns comparator plus 10 ns logic delay; the maximum-RC monotonic envelope (Rdiag 1.057 Mohm, Rwindow 102 kohm, Cbound 1.30 nF, 15 pF output-load assumption) bounds total detector time at 1.323576 ms. The actual passive unit transient contract is -0.2..+2.5 V, >=1 kohm source, >=10 us edge, <=1 ms pulse, <=1 Hz repetition; clamp sum is zero and capacitor energy is <=4.7385 nJ. The same RTDIN-pin transient solver steps healthy 100/194.1 ohm to 10/0 ohm and observes all four short transitions at 0.001065 ms; the 1.323576 ms passive envelope is retained as the bound. The fault NAND is adopted upstream-powered so local RTD_AVDD loss drives RESET low and releases the upstream pullup without relying on an intermediate brownout Ioff state. Local-off external drive is forbidden and rail monitor/HW fault owns shutdown. Conditional SINC evidence remains separate and must not be treated as vendor timing proof.

shared_reference.source_issue: Top currently assigns OVP_VREF_2V5 and OCP2_VREF_2V5 to the same physical REF2025.VREF; names falsely imply two references
shared_reference.loading: The internal RTD VBIAS divider load is 96.242 uA; it is distinct from this shared VREF net. The standalone J2 pin 10 boundary contract allows <=100 uA external source/sink load and <=10 nF external capacitance. REF2025 output limit is +/-20 mA, but that device rating does not replace the authored boundary load limit. Future OVP/OCP2 consumers must fit the external budget.

model_status: bounded passive/DC comparator polarity with protected RTDIN_P branch, paired diagnostic-loading, 65536-corner mismatch sweep, and RTDIN-pin runtime-open transient model under the declared passive envelope; historical SINC phase evidence is separate and conditional; no PVT, vendor macro-model, arbitrary external-break waveform, physical wiring, EMC, internal MAX switch, or shutdown proof

high_window_trip_boundary_ohm_estimate.meaning: The independent hardware HIGH comparator can trip before the 300 ohm firmware open threshold. It is guaranteed clear through about 262.7 ohm, corner/offset dependent from about 262.7 to 293.6 ohm, and guaranteed fault by 300 ohm under the declared model. This is intentional coarse-window behavior only if the system accepts the earlier trip.
